class.name: JRPGMapList
class.brief_description: The project's maps: their IDs, names, tree order and scene files.
class.description: The map list ([code]res://jrpg/map_list.tres[/code]) is the source of truth for map IDs. Each map is a dictionary with [code]map_id[/code], [code]name[/code], [code]parent_id[/code] (0 for the top level) and [code]scene[/code] (the path of its scene). The list order is the tree order. IDs are never reused: a removed map's ID never comes back for another map.

method.name: add_map
method.description: Adds a map at the end of the children of [param parent_id] and returns its new ID, or 0 when [param parent_id] is not a map.

method.name: add_map_with_id
method.description: Adds a map with an ID found elsewhere (a scene scan). Fails when the ID is in use.

method.name: find_by_scene
method.description: Returns the ID of the map whose scene is [param scene], or 0.

method.name: get_children
method.description: Returns the maps directly under [param parent_id] (0 for the top level), in order.

method.name: get_map
method.description: Returns a copy of the map [param map_id], or an empty dictionary.

method.name: get_map_ids
method.description: Returns every map ID in tree order.

method.name: get_scene
method.description: Returns the scene path of the map [param map_id], or an empty string.

method.name: has_map
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the list has the map [param map_id].

method.name: move_map
method.description: Moves the map [param map_id], with the maps under it, under [param parent_id] (0 for the top level), before its [param index]-th new sibling ([code]-1[/code] or past the last: after them). Fails when [param parent_id] is the map or one of the maps under it.

method.name: remove_map
method.description: Removes the map [param map_id]. Its children move up to its parent.

method.name: reserve_id
method.description: Returns an ID never handed out before.

method.name: set_scene
method.description: Sets the scene path of the map [param map_id].

method.name: upgrade
method.description: Brings a list saved by an older version of Talewright to the current format by running its migration steps, then sets [member schema_version] to [constant CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION]; an unstamped list is stamped. A list saved by a newer version is left unchanged and a warning is printed. Loading a list calls it once its maps are loaded.

members.member: The maps in tree order. Entries without a positive, unique [code]map_id[/code] are dropped with a warning. A map whose parent the list does not have, or that would be its own ancestor, moves to the top level, and maps out of tree order are put back in it, with a warning.
The ID the next new map gets. It only grows.

Version of the list's data format, used to upgrade lists saved by older versions. [constant SCHEMA_UNSTAMPED] (-1) until the content first changes; any change stamps [constant CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION]. The default is never a real version, so every saved list records it.

constants.constant: The data format version this build writes.
The [member schema_version] of a list whose content never changed: never a real version.
